basics.headline: Warehouse Supervisor moving into Logistics Coordination
basics.summary: Eleven years on the warehouse floor, the last four supervising a 30-person shift. Moving into logistics coordination, with route and inventory planning already a daily part of the job.

work.summary: Regional distribution centre, 30-person shift across two docks.
highlights: Supervise a 30-person shift across inbound and outbound docks.
Rebuilt the pick-path layout after mapping where pickers actually walked.
Run the weekly cycle-count programme and reconcile discrepancies.
Trained the team through the migration to a new warehouse management system.
Picked, packed and loaded outbound orders on a rotating shift.
Became the shift's reference point for the labelling exceptions nobody else wanted.
Loaded and unloaded regional distribution routes.
Studied part-time alongside full-time shift work.

projects.name: Pick-path redesign
projects.description: Remapped the picking route of the regional distribution centre after tracking actual walking patterns over three weeks.
highlights: Observed and recorded real pick routes rather than working from the plan on file.
Reorganised fast-moving stock into the shortest walk from the dispatch dock.

projects.name: WMS migration support
projects.description: Prepared and trained a 30-person shift through a warehouse management system change.
highlights: Wrote the shift's quick-reference sheets in plain language.
Ran floor-side training during live operation without stopping dispatch.

certifications.name: Prevención de riesgos laborales, nivel básico

highlights: Coordinate the monthly food-collection intake and storage.
